birth.note: Back-calculated: he died in Ṣafar 853 "having approached forty" (qad qāraba al-arbaʿīn), i.e. born c. 813-815 AH. Not stated in the text.

death.note: "He died of the plague in Ṣafar of the year [8]53, having approached forty."

relation.note: Ṭūghān al-Ḥasanī al-Ẓāhirī Barqūq, the dawādār, "known as al-Majnūn" (AIND-D03440). "His father died while he was a small child."

relation.desc: صاهر التاج البلقيني على ابنته جنة فلم يثبت معها
relation.note: Janna bint al-Tāj Muḥammad b. al-Jalāl ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Bulqīnī (AIND-D12934), whose entry lists "al-Nāṣirī Muḥammad b. Ṭūghān" as the second of her husbands. The marriage did not last.
Al-Tāj Abū Salama Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿUmar b. Raslān al-Bulqīnī (AIND-D07568), father of Janna.

relation.desc: تزوج ابنة أخت الشمس بن المرخم فاستولدها ولدا
relation.note: Unnamed daughter of the sister of al-Shams b. al-Murakhkham; she bore him a son (the son is not described and is not encoded, rule 14).

Maternal uncle of his second wife. Al-Shams b. al-Murakhkham is most probably Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. Muḥammad b. Qāsim al-Shams al-Qāhirī al-Bahāʾī al-Shāfiʿī, "known as Ibn al-Murakhkham after his father's trade" (AIND-D08161, b. 808); the older Ibn al-Murakhkham, al-Tāj Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (AIND-D07610, 765-840), is a less likely alternative, hence cert="medium".

person.note: محمد بن طوغان الحسني الماضي أبوه . مات أبوه وهو طفل فنشأ متشاغلا باللهو واللعب وصاهر التاج البلقيني على ابنته جنة فلم يثبت معها ، وتزوج ابنة أخت الشمس بن المرخم فاستولدها ولدا . ومات بالطاعون في صفر سنة ثلاث وخمسين وقد قارب الأربعين .
ムハンマド・ブン・トゥーガーン・アル＝ハサニー。その父は前述。父は彼が幼児のときに没し、彼は遊びと戯れにかまけて育った。アッ＝タージュ・アル＝バルキーニーの娘ジャンナと結婚して同家と姻戚となったが、彼女とは続かなかった。また、アッ＝シャムス・ブン・アル＝ムラッハムの姉妹の娘を娶り、彼女との間に男児をもうけた。［ヒジュラ暦8］53年サファル月にペストで没した。四十歳に近づいていた。

Muḥammad b. Ṭūghān al-Ḥasanī, whose father is mentioned above. His father died while he was a small child, and he grew up occupied with amusement and play. He became son-in-law of al-Tāj al-Bulqīnī by marrying his daughter Janna, but did not stay with her; then he married the daughter of the sister of al-Shams b. al-Murakhkham, and she bore him a son. He died of the plague in Ṣafar of the year [8]53, having approached forty.
